Google Ads announced a new Invalid Traffic (IVT) overview card within Google Search. Google's Keerat Sharma wrote, "We’re rolling out the Invalid Traffic Overview Card in Google Ads to give advertisers front-end transparency into how we protect their campaigns."
This will allow advertisers to see the actual amount saved and the credits Google automatically provides for invalid activity.
"We don’t charge for invalid traffic, and our multi-layered defenses have always worked in the background to catch it before an advertiser is billed. We issue a credit when it’s detected later, where appropriate and possible. Now, for the first time, businesses can see both the amount saved and the credits we automatically provide for invalid activity," Keerat Sharma added. "So far in 2026, we’ve reduced advertiser exposure to invalid leads by an average of 30% through continuous system upgrades," Keerat added.
